proves.claim: A dead seat claim lapsed past 120 minutes is released by the coordinator after another item event lands during the observation.

cli.journeys-release-stale.dead-seat-cla.why: Without it, a regression where a dead seat claim lapsed past 120 minutes is released by the coordinator after another item event lands during the observation would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A lapsed claim whose holder heartbeat is live is refused and is not a dead seat claim.

cli.journeys-release-stale.live-heartbea.why: Without it, a regression where a lapsed claim whose holder heartbeat is live is refused and is not a dead seat claim would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The coordinator CLI release --stale frees a dead seat claim lapsed past 120 minutes in a stall window.

cli.journeys-release-stale.dead-seat-rea.why: Without it, a regression where the coordinator CLI release --stale frees a dead seat claim lapsed past 120 minutes in a stall window would pass unnoticed.
